tEn: Geometric Deep Learning: Grids, Groups, Graphs, Geodesics, and Gauges
tZh: 几何深度学习：网格、群、图、测地线与规范
sEn: Deep learning's success stems from exploiting structural regularities in data, which can be unified through geometric principles to understand and design neural architectures.
sZh: 深度学习的成功源于利用数据中的结构规律，这些规律可通过几何原理加以统一，从而理解和设计神经网络架构。
absEn: The last decade has witnessed an experimental revolution in data science and machine learning, epitomised by deep learning methods. Indeed, many high-dimensional learning tasks previously thought to be beyond reach -- such as computer vision, playing Go, or protein folding -- are in fact feasible with appropriate computational scale. Remarkably, the essence of deep learning is built from two simple algorithmic principles: first, the notion of representation or feature learning, whereby adapted, often hierarchical, features capture the appropriate notion of regularity for each task, and second, learning by local gradient-descent type methods, typically implemented as backpropagation. While learning generic functions in high dimensions is a cursed estimation problem, most tasks of interest are not generic, and come with essential pre-defined regularities arising from the underlying low-dimensionality and structure of the physical world. This text is concerned with exposing these regularities through unified geometric principles that can be applied throughout a wide spectrum of applications. Such a 'geometric unification' endeavour, in the spirit of Felix Klein's Erlangen Program, serves a dual purpose: on one hand, it provides a common mathematical framework to study the most successful neural network architectures, such as CNNs, RNNs, GNNs, and Transformers. On the other hand, it gives a constructive procedure to incorporate prior physical knowledge into neural architectures and provide principled way to build future architectures yet to be invented.
absZh: 过去十年见证了数据科学和机器学习中的一场实验革命，其典型代表便是深度学习方法。事实上，许多先前被认为遥不可及的高维学习任务——如计算机视觉、下围棋或蛋白质折叠——在适当的计算规模下确实可行。值得注意的是，深度学习的本质建立在两个简单的算法原则之上：其一，表示学习或特征学习的概念，即通过自适应的、往往是层次化的特征来捕捉每项任务相应的规律性；其二，通过局部梯度下降类方法进行学习，通常以反向传播实现。虽然在高维空间中学习通用函数是一个受维数灾难困扰的估计问题，但大多数感兴趣的任务并非通用，它们带有由物理世界底层低维性和结构所决定的基本预定义规律。本文旨在通过统一的几何原理来揭示这些规律，这些原理可广泛应用于各类领域。这种秉承菲利克斯·克莱因埃朗根纲领精神的“几何统一”努力具有双重目的：一方面，它为研究最成功的神经网络架构（如CNN、RNN、GNN和Transformer）提供了一个共同的数学框架；另一方面，它提供了一种建设性程序，将先验物理知识融入神经架构，并为尚未发明的未来架构提供原则性的构建方法。

paras.en: For nearly two millennia since Euclid’s Elements, the word ‘geometry’ has been synonymous with Euclidean geometry, as no other types of geometry existed. Euclid’s monopoly came to an end in the nineteenth century, with examples of non-Euclidean geometries constructed by Lobachevsky, Bolyai, Gauss, and Riemann. Towards the end of that century, these studies had diverged into disparate fields, with mathematicians and philosophers debating the validity of and relations between these geometries as well as the nature of the “one true geometry”.
paras.zh: 自欧几里得《几何原本》以来近两千年间，“几何”一词一直是欧几里得几何的同义词，因为当时不存在其他类型的几何。欧几里得的垄断地位在十九世纪被打破，罗巴切夫斯基、鲍耶、高斯和黎曼构造了非欧几里得几何的例子。到那个世纪末，这些研究已分化为不同的领域，数学家和哲学家们争论着这些几何的有效性及其相互关系，以及“唯一真实几何”的本质。

paras.en: A way out of this pickle was shown by a young mathematician Felix Klein, appointed in 1872 as professor in the small Bavarian University of Erlangen. In a research prospectus, which entered the annals of mathematics as the Erlangen Programme, Klein proposed approaching geometry as the study of invariants, i.e. properties unchanged under some class of transformations.
paras.zh: 一位年轻数学家菲利克斯·克莱因（Felix Klein）指出了摆脱这一困境的方法；他于1872年被任命为巴伐利亚小城埃尔朗根大学的教授。在一份研究计划书中——该计划书作为埃尔朗根纲领载入数学史册——克莱因提出将几何学视为对不变量的研究，即在某类变换下保持不变的性质。

paras.en: Called the symmetries of the geometry. This approach created clarity by showing that various geometries known at the time could be defined by an appropriate choice of symmetry transformations, formalized using the language of group theory. For instance, Euclidean geometry is concerned with lengths and angles, because these properties are preserved by the group of Euclidean transformations (rotations and translations), while affine geometry studies parallelism, which is preserved by the group of affine transformations. The relation between these geometries is immediately apparent when considering the respective groups, because the Euclidean group is a subgroup of the affine group, which in turn is a subgroup of the group of projective transformations. The impact of the Erlangen Programme on geometry was very profound. Furthermore, it spilled to other fields, especially physics, where symmetry principles allowed to derive conservation laws from first principles of symmetry (an astonishing result known as Noether’s Theorem), and even enabled the classification of elementary particles as irreducible representations of the symmetry group. Category theory, now pervasive in pure mathematics, can be “regarded as a continuation of the Klein Erlangen Programme, in the sense that a geometrical space with its group of transformations is generalized to a category with its algebra of mappings”, in the words of its creators Samuel Eilenberg and Saunders Mac Lane.
paras.zh: 这些变换被称为几何的对称性。这种方法通过表明当时已知的各种几何都可由适当的对称变换选择来定义（用群论语言加以形式化），从而带来了清晰性。例如，欧几里得几何关注长度和角度，因为这些性质在欧几里得变换群（旋转和平移）下保持不变；而仿射几何研究平行性，它在仿射变换群下保持不变。在考虑各自的群时，这些几何之间的关系立即可见，因为欧几里得群是仿射群的子群，而仿射群又是射影变换群的子群。埃尔朗根纲领对几何学的影响非常深远。此外，它还波及了其他领域，尤其是物理学：对称性原理允许从对称性的第一性原理推导出守恒定律（这一惊人结果被称为诺特定理），甚至能够将基本粒子分类为对称群的不可约表示。范畴论如今在纯数学中无处不在，正如其创立者塞缪尔·艾伦伯格（Samuel Eilenberg）和桑德斯·麦克莱恩（Saunders Mac Lane）所说，它可以“被视为克莱因埃尔朗根纲领的延续，即带变换群的几何空间被推广为带映射代数的范畴”。

paras.zh: 在撰写本文时，深度学习领域的状况有些……

paras.en: Reminiscent of the field of geometry in the nineteenth century, there is a veritable zoo of neural network architectures for various kinds of data, but few unifying principles. As in times past, this makes it difficult to understand the relations between various methods, inevitably resulting in the reinvention and re-branding of the same concepts in different application domains. For a novice trying to learn the field, absorbing the sheer volume of redundant ideas is a true nightmare.
paras.zh: 这让人想起十九世纪的几何学领域。针对各种类型的数据，神经网络架构林林总总，但统一的原则却寥寥无几。与过去一样，这使得理解不同方法之间的关系变得困难，不可避免地导致同一概念在不同应用领域中被重新发明和重新包装。对于试图学习该领域的新手来说，吸收如此大量冗余的想法真是一场噩梦。

paras.en: In this text, we make a modest attempt to apply the Erlangen Programme mindset to the domain of deep learning, with the ultimate goal of obtaining a systematisation of this field and ‘connecting the dots’. We call this geometrisation attempt ‘Geometric Deep Learning’, and true to the spirit of Felix Klein, propose to derive different inductive biases and network architectures implementing them from first principles of symmetry and invariance. In particular, we focus on a large class of neural networks designed for analysing unstructured sets, grids, graphs, and manifolds, and show that they can be understood in a unified manner as methods that respect the structure and symmetries of these domains.
paras.zh: 在本文中，我们尝试将 Erlangen 纲领的思路应用到深度学习领域，最终目标是使这一领域系统化并‘连接各个点’。我们将这一几何化尝试称为‘几何深度学习’，并本着 Felix Klein 的精神，提出从对称性和不变性的第一性原理出发，推导不同的归纳偏置以及实现这些偏置的网络架构。特别地，我们关注一大类用于分析非结构化集合、网格、图和流形的神经网络，并表明它们可以被统一地理解为尊重这些域的结构和对称性的方法。

paras.en: We believe this text would appeal to a broad audience of deep learning researchers, practitioners, and enthusiasts. A novice may use it as an overview and introduction to Geometric Deep Learning. A seasoned deep learning expert may discover new ways of deriving familiar architectures from basic principles and perhaps some surprising connections. Practitioners may get new insights on how to solve problems in their respective fields.
paras.zh: 我们相信，本文会吸引广泛的深度学习研究者、实践者和爱好者。新手可以把它作为几何深度学习的概览和入门；资深的深度学习专家可能会发现从基本原理推导出熟悉架构的新方法，甚至一些令人惊讶的联系；实践者则可能获得如何解决各自领域中问题的新见解。

paras.en: With such a fast-paced field as modern machine learning, the risk of writing a text like this is that it becomes obsolete and irrelevant before it sees the light of day. Having focused on foundations, our hope is that the key concepts we discuss will transcend their specific realisations — or, as Claude Adrien Helvétius put it, “la connaissance de certains principes supplée facilement à la connoissance de certains faits.”
paras.zh: 面对现代机器学习这样一个快速发展的领域，写作这样一篇文章的风险在于，它可能在面世之前就已过时且失去意义。由于我们聚焦于基础，我们希望我们所讨论的关键概念能够超越它们的具体实现——或者，正如 Claude Adrien Helvétius 所言：“某些原理的知识可以轻易弥补某些事实知识的缺失。”

paras.en: “The knowledge of certain principles easily compensates the lack of knowledge of certain facts.” (Helvétius)
paras.zh: “某些原理的知识可以轻易弥补某些事实知识的缺失。”（Helvétius）

This text is concerned with exposing these regularities through unified geometric principles that can be applied throughout a wide spectrum of applications.
paras.zh: 虽然在高维空间中学习通用函数是一个受维度诅咒的估计问题，但大多数感兴趣的任务并非通用，它们带有源于物理世界底层低维性和结构的基本预定义规律。本文旨在通过统一的几何原理来揭示这些规律，这些原理可在广泛的应用中发挥作用。

paras.en: Exploiting the known symmetries of a large system is a powerful and classical remedy against the curse of dimensionality, and forms the basis of most physical theories. Deep learning systems are no exception, and since the early days researchers have adapted neural networks to exploit the low-dimensional geometry arising from physical measurements, e.g. grids in images, sequences in time-series, or position and momentum in molecules, and their associated symmetries, such as translation or rotation. Throughout our exposition, we will describe these models, as well as many others, as natural instances of the same underlying principle of geometric regularity.
paras.zh: 利用大型系统的已知对称性是应对维度诅咒的一种强大而经典的方法，也是大多数物理理论的基础。深度学习系统也不例外，自早期以来，研究者们就调整神经网络以利用物理测量中产生的低维几何结构，例如图像中的网格、时间序列中的序列，或分子中的位置和动量，以及它们相关的对称性，如平移或旋转。在整个论述中，我们将把这些模型以及许多其他模型描述为同一几何规律性基本原理的自然实例。

paras.en: Such a ‘geometric unification’ endeavour in the spirit of the Erlangen Program serves a dual purpose: on the one hand, it provides a common mathematical framework to study the most successful neural network architectures, such as CNNs, RNNs, GNNs, and Transformers. On the other hand, it gives a constructive procedure to incorporate prior physical knowledge into neural architectures and provide a principled way to build future architectures yet to be invented.
paras.zh: 这种秉承埃尔朗根纲领精神的‘几何统一’尝试具有双重目的：一方面，它为研究最成功的神经网络架构（如CNN、RNN、GNN和Transformer）提供了一个共同的数学框架；另一方面，它提供了一种将先验物理知识纳入神经架构的构造性方法，并为尚未发明的未来架构提供了有原则的构建途径。

paras.en: Before proceeding, it is worth noting that our work concerns representation learning architectures and exploiting the symmetries of data therein. The many exciting pipelines where such representations may be used (such as

paras.en: Other paradigms—self-supervised learning, generative modelling, or reinforcement learning—are not our central focus. Hence, we will not review in depth influential techniques used for optimising or regularising our architectures, such as Adam (Kingma and Ba, 2014), dropout (Srivastava et al., 2014), or batch normalisation (Ioffe and Szegedy, 2015). The same applies to neural pipelines such as variational autoencoders (Kingma and Welling, 2013), generative adversarial networks (Goodfellow et al., 2014), normalising flows (Rezende and Mohamed, 2015), deep Q-networks (Mnih et al., 2015), proximal policy optimisation (Schulman et al., 2017), or deep mutual information maximisation (Hjelm et al., 2019). That being said, we believe that the principles we will focus on are of significant importance in all of these areas.
paras.zh: 其他范式——自监督学习、生成建模或强化学习——并非我们的核心关注点。因此，我们不会深入回顾用于优化或正则化我们架构的有影响力技术，例如 Adam（Kingma 和 Ba, 2014）、dropout（Srivastava 等, 2014）或批归一化（Ioffe 和 Szegedy, 2015）。这同样适用于神经流水线，如变分自编码器（Kingma 和 Welling, 2013）、生成对抗网络（Goodfellow 等, 2014）、归一化流（Rezende 和 Mohamed, 2015）、深度 Q 网络（Mnih 等, 2015）、近端策略优化（Schulman 等, 2017）或深度互信息最大化（Hjelm 等, 2019）。话虽如此，我们相信我们所关注的原则在这些领域中都具有重要意义。

paras.en: Further, while we have attempted to cast a reasonably wide net in order to illustrate the power of our geometric blueprint, our work does not attempt to accurately summarise the entire existing wealth of research on Geometric Deep Learning. Rather, we study several well-known architectures in-depth in order to demonstrate the principles and ground them in existing research, with the hope that we have left sufficient references for the reader to meaningfully apply these principles to any future geometric deep architecture they encounter or devise.
paras.zh: 此外，尽管我们试图撒下一张相当宽的网来说明我们几何蓝图的威力，但我们的工作并不试图准确总结现有关于几何深度学习的全部丰富研究。相反，我们深入研究了几个众所周知的架构，以展示这些原则并将其与现有研究相结合，希望我们为读者留下足够的参考文献，使其能够有意义地将这些原则应用于他们遇到或设计的任何未来几何深度架构。

paras.en: Supervised machine learning, in its simplest formalisation, considers a set of N observations \(D = \{ (x_i, y_i) \}_{i=1}^N\) drawn i.i.d. from an underlying data distribution P defined over X × Y, where X and Y are respectively the data and the label domains. The defining feature in this setup is that X is a high-dimensional space: one typically assumes \(X = \mathbb{R}^d\) to be a Euclidean space of large dimension d.
paras.zh: 监督机器学习在其最简单的形式化中，考虑由 N 个观测 \(D = \{ (x_i, y_i) \}_{i=1}^N\) 构成的集合，这些观测是从定义在 X × Y 上的潜在数据分布 P 中独立同分布地抽取的，其中 X 和 Y 分别是数据和标签域。该设置的一个显著特征是 X 是高维空间：通常假设 \(X = \mathbb{R}^d\) 是维度 d 较大的欧几里得空间。

paras.en: Let us further assume that the labels y are generated by an unknown function f, such that \(y_i = f(x_i)\), and the learning problem reduces to estimating the function f using a parametrised function class \(F = \{ f_\theta \}_{\theta \in \Theta}\). Neural networks are a common realisation of such parametric function classes, in which case \(\theta \in \Theta\) corresponds to the network weights. In this idealised setup, there is no noise in the labels, and modern deep learning systems typically operate in the so-called interpolating regime, where the estimated \(\tilde{f} \in F\) satisfies \(\tilde{f}(x_i) = f(x_i)\) for all \(i = 1, \ldots, N\). The performance of a learning algorithm is measured in terms of the expected performance on new samples drawn from P. Statistical learning theory is concerned with more refined notions of generalisation based on concentration inequalities; we will review some of these in future work.
paras.zh: 我们进一步假设标签 y 由一个未知函数 f 生成，使得 \(y_i = f(x_i)\)，则学习问题就归结为使用参数化函数类 \(F = \{ f_\theta \}_{\theta \in \Theta}\) 来估计函数 f。神经网络是这类参数化函数类的常见实现，此时 \(\theta \in \Theta\) 对应于网络权重。在这种理想化设置中，标签没有噪声，而现代深度学习系统通常在所谓的插值状态下运行，其中估计的 \(\tilde{f} \in F\) 满足对所有 \(i = 1, \ldots, N\) 有 \(\tilde{f}(x_i) = f(x_i)\)。学习算法的性能通过在新样本上的期望性能来衡量。统计学习理论关注基于集中不等式的更精细的泛化概念；我们将在未来工作中回顾其中的一些内容。
