paras.zh: 如果对于任意置换矩阵 \(P\)，都有 \(F(PX) = PF(X)\)。共享的逐节点线性变换

paras.en: \(F_\Theta(X) = X\Theta\) (7), specified by a weight matrix \(\Theta \in \mathbb{R}^{d\times d}\), is one possible construction of such a permutation equivariant function, producing in our example latent features of the form \(h_u = \Theta^{\top} x_u\).
paras.zh: 由权重矩阵 \(\Theta \in \mathbb{R}^{d\times d}\) 指定的 \(F_\Theta(X) = X\Theta\) (7)，是这种置换等变函数的一种可能构造，在我们的例子中产生形如 \(h_u = \Theta^{\top} x_u\) 的潜在特征。

paras.en: This construction arises naturally from our Geometric Deep Learning blueprint. We can first attempt to characterise linear equivariants (functions of the form \(F(PX) = PF(X)\)), for which it is easy to verify that any such map can be written as a linear combination of two generators, the identity \(F_1X = X\) and the average \(F_2X = \frac{1}{n}\mathbf{1}\mathbf{1}^{\top}X = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{u=1}^{n}x_u\). As will be described in Section 5.4, the popular Deep Sets (Zaheer et al., 2017) architecture follows precisely this blueprint.
paras.zh: 这种构造天然源于我们的几何深度学习蓝图。我们可以首先尝试刻画线性等变映射（形如 \(F(PX)=PF(X)\) 的函数），容易验证任何此类映射都可以写成两个生成元的线性组合：恒等映射 \(F_1X = X\) 和平均映射 \(F_2X = \frac{1}{n}\mathbf{1}\mathbf{1}^{\top}X = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{u=1}^{n}x_u\)。如第 5.4 节所述，流行的 Deep Sets (Zaheer et al., 2017) 架构正是遵循这一蓝图。

paras.en: We can now generalise the notions of permutation invariance and equivariance from sets to graphs. In the generic setting \(E \neq \emptyset\), the graph connectivity can be represented by the \(n \times n\) adjacency matrix \(A\), defined as \(a_{uv} = 1\) if \((u,v) \in E\) and \(a_{uv} = 0\) otherwise (8). When the graph is undirected, i.e. \((u,v) \in E\) iff \((v,u) \in E\), the adjacency matrix is symmetric, \(A = A^{\top}\).
paras.zh: 现在我们可以将置换不变性和置换等变性的概念从集合推广到图。在一般情形 \(E \neq \emptyset\) 下，图的连通性可以用 \(n \times n\) 邻接矩阵 \(A\) 表示，定义为：若 \((u,v) \in E\)，则 \(a_{uv}=1\)，否则 \(a_{uv}=0\)（式 8）。当图是无向图时，即 \((u,v) \in E\) 当且仅当 \((v,u) \in E\)，邻接矩阵是对称的，\(A = A^{\top}\)。

paras.en: Note that now the adjacency and feature matrices \(A\) and \(X\) are “synchronised”, in the sense that \(a_{uv}\) specifies the adjacency information between the nodes described by the \(u\)-th and \(v\)-th rows of \(X\). Therefore, applying a permutation matrix \(P\) to the node features \(X\) automatically implies applying it to \(A\)’s rows and columns, \(P A P^{\top}\). We say that a graph-wise function \(f\) is permutation invariant if it is invariant under the representation of \(\Sigma_n\) acting on matrices.
paras.zh: 注意，现在邻接矩阵和特征矩阵 \(A\) 和 \(X\) 是“同步”的，即 \(a_{uv}\) 指定了由 \(X\) 的第 \(u\) 行和第 \(v\) 行所描述节点之间的邻接信息。因此，将置换矩阵 \(P\) 应用于节点特征 \(X\)，会自动地意味着将其应用于 \(A\) 的行和列，即 \(P A P^{\top}\)。我们说，如果图级函数 \(f\) 在 \(\Sigma_n\) 作用于矩阵的表示下不变，则它是置换不变的。

paras.en: As a way to emphasise the fact that our functions operating over graphs now need to take into account the adjacency information, we use the notation \(f(X, A)\). A (graph-level) function \(f\) is permutation invariant if \(f(PX, PAP^T) = f(X, A)\ (9), and a node-wise function \(F\) is permutation equivariant if \(F(PX, PAP^T) = P F(X, A)\ (10).
paras.zh: 为了强调我们作用于图的函数现在需要考虑邻接信息，我们使用记号 \(f(X, A)\)。（图级）函数 \(f\) 是置换不变的，如果 \(f(PX, PAP^T) = f(X, A)\ (9)；而（节点级）函数 \(F\) 是置换等变的，如果 \(F(PX, PAP^T) = P F(X, A)\ (10)。

paras.en: Here again, we can first characterise linear equivariant functions. As observed by Maron et al. (2018), any linear \(F\) satisfying equation (10) can be expressed as a linear combination of fifteen linear generators; remarkably, this corresponds to the Bell number \(B_4\), which counts the number of ways to partition a set of 4 elements, in this case given by the 4 indices \((u, v), (u', v'))\ indexing a linear map acting on the adjacency matrix.
paras.zh: 在这里，我们同样可以先刻画线性等变函数。正如 Maron 等人（2018）所观察到的，任何满足式 (10) 的线性 \(F\) 都可以表示为十五个线性生成元的线性组合；值得注意的是，这对应于 Bell 数 \(B_4\)，它计算将 4 个元素集合划分为子集的方式数，在这里由索引邻接矩阵上线性映射的 4 个索引 \((u, v), (u', v'))\ 给出。

paras.en: This family of generators is independent of n. Amongst these generators, our blueprint specifically advocates for those that are also local, i.e., whereby the output on node u directly depends on its neighbouring nodes in the graph. We can formalise this constraint explicitly in our model construction, by defining what it means for a node to be neighbouring another.
paras.zh: 这一族生成器与 n 无关。在这些生成器中，我们的蓝图特别提倡那些具有局部性的生成器，即节点 u 的输出直接依赖于其在图中的相邻节点。我们可以在模型构造中明确地形式化这一约束，通过定义节点之间的相邻关系。

paras.en: An (undirected) neighbourhood of node u, sometimes also called 1-hop, is often defined as the set of nodes connected to u by an edge. The node u itself is sometimes included in its own neighbourhood. Formally, the neighbourhood is defined as N_u = {v : (u, v) ∈ E or (v, u) ∈ E} (11). The neighbourhood features are then represented as the multiset X_{N_u} = {{x_v : v ∈ N_u}} (12). A multiset, denoted {{ . . . }}, is a set where the same element can appear more than once. This is the case here because nodes can be equal.
paras.zh: 节点 u 的（无向）邻域，有时也称为 1 跳邻域，通常定义为通过边与 u 相连的节点集合。有时节点 u 本身也被包含在其自身的邻域中。形式上，邻域定义为 N_u = {v : (u, v) ∈ E 或 (v, u) ∈ E} (11)。邻域特征则表示为多重集 X_{N_u} = {{x_v : v ∈ N_u}} (12)。多重集，记作 {{ . . . }}，是允许同一元素出现多次的集合。这里之所以如此，是因为节点可能相同。

paras.en: Operating on 1-hop neighbourhoods aligns well with the locality aspect of our blueprint: namely, defining our metric over graphs as the shortest path distance between nodes using edges in E. The features of different nodes can be equal.
paras.zh: 在 1 跳邻域上操作与蓝图的局部性方面高度一致：即，将图上的度量定义为使用 E 中边的节点间最短路径距离。不同节点的特征可能相同。

paras.en:
The GDL blueprint thus yields a general recipe for constructing permutation equivariant functions on graphs, by specifying a local function φ that operates over the features of a node and its neighbourhood, φ(xu , XNu ). Then, a permutation equivariant function F can be constructed by applying φ to every node’s neighbourhood in isolation (see Figure 10):
\[ F(X, A) = \begin{bmatrix} φ(x_1, X_{N_1}) \\ φ(x_2, X_{N_2}) \\ \vdots \\ φ(x_n, X_{N_n}) \end{bmatrix} \tag{13} \]
paras.zh:
因此，GDL 蓝图提供了一种在图上构造置换等变函数的通用方法，即指定一个局部函数 φ，该函数作用于节点及其邻域的特征，φ(xu , XNu )。然后，通过将 φ 独立地应用于每个节点的邻域，可以构造置换等变函数 F（见图 10）：
\[ F(X, A) = \begin{bmatrix} φ(x_1, X_{N_1}) \\ φ(x_2, X_{N_2}) \\ \vdots \\ φ(x_n, X_{N_n}) \end{bmatrix} \tag{13} \]

paras.en: As F is constructed by applying a shared function φ to each node locally, its permutation equivariance rests on φ’s output being independent of the ordering of the nodes in Nu . Thus, if φ is built to be permutation invariant, then this property is satisfied. As we will see in future work, the choice of φ plays a crucial role in the expressive power of such a scheme. When φ is injective, it is equivalent to one step of the Weisfeiler-Lehman graph isomorphism test, a classical algorithm in graph theory providing a necessary condition for two graphs to be isomorphic by an iterative color refinement procedure.
paras.zh: 由于 F 是通过将共享函数 φ 局部应用于每个节点而构造的，其置换等变性依赖于 φ 的输出与 Nu 中节点的顺序无关。因此，如果 φ 被构建为置换不变的，则该性质得到满足。正如我们将在未来的工作中看到的，φ 的选择对此类方案的表达能力起着至关重要的作用。当 φ 是单射时，它等价于 Weisfeiler-Lehman 图同构测试的一步，这是图论中的经典算法，通过迭代颜色细化过程为两个图是否同构提供必要条件。

paras.en: It is also worth noticing that the difference between functions defined on sets and more general graphs in this example is that in the latter case we need to explicitly account for the structure of the domain. As a consequence, graphs stand apart in the sense that the domain becomes part of the input in machine learning.
paras.zh: 还值得注意的是，在此示例中，定义在集合上的函数与定义在更一般图上的函数之间的区别在于，在后一种情况下，我们需要显式地考虑定义域的结构。因此，图之所以与众不同，是因为定义域成为机器学习输入的一部分。

paras.en: In learning problems, whereas when dealing with sets and grids (both particular cases of graphs) we can specify only the features and assume the domain to be fixed. This distinction will be a recurring motif in our discussion. As a result, the notion of geometric stability (invariance to domain deformation) is crucial in most problems of learning on graphs. It straightforwardly follows from our construction that permutation invariant and equivariant functions produce identical outputs on isomorphic (topologically-equivalent) graphs. These results can be generalised to approximately isomorphic graphs, and several results on stability under graph perturbations exist (Levie et al., 2018). We will return to this important point in our discussion on manifolds, which we will use as a vehicle to study such invariance in further detail.
paras.zh: 在学习问题中，当处理集合和网格（两者都是图的特例）时，我们只能指定特征并假设域是固定的。这一区别将是我们讨论中反复出现的主题。因此，几何稳定性（对域变形的不变性）的概念在图上的大多数学习问题中至关重要。从我们的构造可以直接得出，置换不变和等变函数在同构（拓扑等价）的图上产生相同的输出。这些结果可以推广到近似同构的图，并且已有若干关于图扰动下稳定性的结果（Levie et al., 2018）。我们将在讨论流形时回到这一重要观点，我们将以流形为载体更详细地研究这种不变性。

paras.en:
Second, due to their additional structure, graphs and grids, unlike sets, can be coarsened in a non-trivial way, giving rise to a variety of pooling operations. More precisely, we cannot define a non-trivial coarsening assuming set structure alone. There exist established approaches that infer topological structure from unordered sets, and those can admit non-trivial coarsening.

**4.2 Grids and Euclidean spaces**

The second type of objects we consider are grids. It is fair to say that the impact of deep learning was particularly dramatic in computer vision, natural language processing, and speech recognition. These applications all share a geometric common denominator: an underlying grid structure.
paras.zh:
其次，由于图和网格具有额外的结构，与集合不同，它们可以以非平凡的方式被粗化，从而产生多种池化操作。更精确地说，仅假设集合结构我们无法定义非平凡的粗化。已有成熟方法从无序集合中推断拓扑结构，这些方法可以允许非平凡的粗化。

**4.2 网格与欧几里得空间**

我们考虑的第二类对象是网格。可以说，深度学习的影响在计算机视觉、自然语言处理和语音识别方面尤为显著。这些应用都有一个共同的几何分母：底层网格结构。

paras.en: As mentioned, grids are a particular case of graphs with special adjacency. However, since the order of nodes in a grid is fixed, machine learning models for signals defined on grids are no longer required to account for permutation invariance, and have a stronger geometric prior: translation invariance.
paras.zh: 如前所述，网格是图的一种特殊情况，具有特殊的邻接关系。然而，由于网格中节点的顺序是固定的，针对网格上信号的机器学习模型不再需要考虑置换不变性，而是具有更强的几何先验：平移不变性。

paras.en: Circulant matrices and Convolutions Let us dwell on this point in more detail. Assuming for simplicity periodic boundary conditions, we can think of a one-dimensional grid as a ring graph with nodes indexed by 0, 1, . . . , n−1 modulo n (which we will omit for notation brevity) and the adjacency matrix with elements a_{u,u+1 mod n} = 1 and zero otherwise. There are two main differences from the general graph case we have discussed before. First, each node u has identical connectivity, to its neighbours u − 1 and u + 1, and thus structure-wise indistinguishable from the others. Second, and more importantly, since the nodes of the grid have a fixed ordering, we also have a fixed ordering of the neighbours: we can call u − 1 the ‘left’ and u + 1 the ‘right’.
paras.zh: 循环矩阵与卷积 让我们更详细地探讨这一点。为简单起见，假设周期性边界条件，我们可以将一维网格视为一个环图，节点索引为 0, 1, ..., n−1（模 n，为简洁起见省略），邻接矩阵的元素为 a_{u,u+1 mod n} = 1，其余为零。这与我们之前讨论的一般图情况有两个主要区别。首先，每个节点 u 与其邻居 u−1 和 u+1 具有相同的连接性，因此在结构上与其他节点无法区分。其次，更重要的是，由于网格节点具有固定的顺序，我们也具有固定的邻居顺序：我们可以称 u−1 为“左”，u+1 为“右”。

paras.en: As we will see later, this makes the grid a homogeneous space.
paras.zh: 正如我们稍后将看到的，这使得网格成为一个齐次空间。

paras.en: neighbour’ and u + 1 the ‘right neighbour’. If we use our previous recipe for designing an equivariant function F using a local aggregation function φ, we now have f (xu ) = φ(xu−1 , xu , xu+1 ) at every node of the grid: φ does not need to be permutation invariant anymore. For a particular choice of a linear transformation φ(xu−1 , xu , xu+1 ) = θ−1 xu−1 + θ0 xu + θ1 xu+1 , we can write F(X) as a matrix product, \[ \begin{bmatrix} \theta_0 & \theta_1 & \theta_{-1} & & \\ & \theta_{-1} & \theta_0 & \theta_1 & \\ & & \ddots & \ddots & \ddots \\ & & & \theta_{-1} & \theta_0 & \theta_1 \\ & & & \theta_1 & \theta_{-1} & \theta_0 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} x_0 \\ x_1 \\ \vdots \\ x_{n-2} \\ x_{n-1} \end{bmatrix} \]
paras.zh: 邻居’和 u+1 为‘右邻居’。如果我们使用之前设计等变函数 F 的配方，采用局部聚合函数 φ，那么现在网格的每个节点上都有 f (xu ) = φ(xu−1 , xu , xu+1 )：φ 不再需要是置换不变的。对于线性变换 φ(xu−1 , xu , xu+1 ) = θ−1 xu−1 + θ0 xu + θ1 xu+1 的特定选择，我们可以将 F(X) 写成矩阵乘积，\[ \begin{bmatrix} \theta_0 & \theta_1 & \theta_{-1} & & \\ & \theta_{-1} & \theta_0 & \theta_1 & \\ & & \ddots & \ddots & \ddots \\ & & & \theta_{-1} & \theta_0 & \theta_1 \\ & & & \theta_1 & \theta_{-1} & \theta_0 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} x_0 \\ x_1 \\ \vdots \\ x_{n-2} \\ x_{n-1} \end{bmatrix} \]

paras.en: Note this very special multi-diagonal structure with one element repeated along each diagonal, sometimes referred to as “weight sharing” in the machine learning literature.
paras.zh: 注意这种非常特殊的多对角结构，每条对角线上重复一个元素，在机器学习文献中有时称为“权重共享”。

paras.en: More generally, given a vector \(\theta = (\theta_0, \ldots, \theta_{n-1})\), a circulant matrix \(C(\theta) = (\theta_{u-v \bmod n})\) is obtained by appending circularly shifted versions of the vector \(\theta\). Because of the periodic boundary conditions, it is a circular or cyclic convolution. Circulant matrices are synonymous with discrete convolutions. In signal processing, \(\theta\) is often referred to as the "filter," and in CNNs, its coefficients are learnable. The convolution operation is defined as \[(x \ast \theta)_u = \sum_{v=0}^{n-1} x_{v \bmod n} \theta_{u-v \bmod n}\].
paras.zh: 更一般地，给定向量 \(\theta = (\theta_0, \ldots, \theta_{n-1})\)，循环矩阵 \(C(\theta) = (\theta_{u-v \bmod n})\) 是通过将向量 \(\theta\) 的循环移位版本附加而获得的。由于周期边界条件，它是圆形或循环卷积。循环矩阵与离散卷积同义。在信号处理中，\(\theta\) 通常被称为“滤波器”，在CNN中，其系数是可学习的。卷积运算定义为 \[(x \ast \theta)_u = \sum_{v=0}^{n-1} x_{v \bmod n} \theta_{u-v \bmod n}\]。

paras.en: as one has C(θ)x = x \ast θ. A particular choice of θ = (0, 1, 0, . . . , 0)\top yields a special circulant matrix that shifts vectors to the right by one position. This matrix is called the (right) shift or translation operator and denoted by S. The left shift operator is given by S\top. Clearly, circulant matrices can be characterized by their commutativity property: C(θ)C(η) = C(η)C(θ) for any θ and η. Since the shift is a circulant matrix, we obtain the familiar orthogonality relations S\top S = SS\top = I, which underlie the translation (or shift) equivariance of the convolution operator.
paras.zh: 因为 \(C(θ)x = x \ast θ\)。特别地，取 \(θ = (0, 1, 0, . . . , 0)\top\) 会得到一个特殊的循环矩阵，它把向量向右平移一位。这个矩阵称为右移（或平移）算子，记作 \(S\)。左移算子为 \(S\top\)。显然，循环矩阵可以用其交换性来刻画：对任意 \(θ\) 和 \(η\)，有 \(C(θ)C(η) = C(η)C(θ)\)。由于移位矩阵本身是循环矩阵，我们得到熟悉的正交关系 \(S\top S = SS\top = I\)，这正是卷积算子平移（或移位）等变性的基础。

paras.en: This commutativity property is not surprising, since the underlying symmetry group (the translation group) is Abelian. Moreover, the converse also appears to hold: a matrix is circulant if and only if it commutes with the shift. This, in turn, allows us to define convolution as a translation-equivariant linear operation, and is a nice illustration of the power of geometric priors and the overall philosophy of Geometric ML: convolution emerges from the first principle of translational symmetry.
paras.zh: 这种交换性并不令人惊讶，因为其背后的对称群（平移群）是阿贝尔交换群。此外，反过来似乎也成立：一个矩阵是循环矩阵，当且仅当它与移位算子交换。这进而使我们可以把卷积定义为平移等变的线性运算，并且很好地说明了几何先验的力量以及几何机器学习（Geometric ML）的总体理念：卷积源于平移对称性的第一性原理。
